# RC Renovations

> Joinery-led renovation firm covering Glasgow and Lanarkshire, Scotland. Time-served
> tradesmen, fixed written quotes and one point of contact from first survey to final
> walkthrough.

RC Renovations carries out kitchen renovations, bathroom renovations, home extensions,
loft conversions, bespoke joinery (fitted wardrobes, media walls, wall panelling),
internal door fitting, flooring (including herringbone LVT and parquet), composite
decking, and full whole-property renovations.

## Coverage area
Glasgow and Lanarkshire, including Hamilton, Bothwell, Motherwell, East Kilbride,
Uddingston, Blantyre, Cambuslang, Rutherglen, Wishaw and Bellshill. No travel charges
within this area.

- Phone / WhatsApp: 07496 410353

## How we work
Free home survey, fixed written quote (usually within 48 hours), an agreed start date
and programme before any work begins, and a walkthrough with the customer at
completion. Reviewed 5/5 on Google by verified customers.
